title: SAT Inference Questions: 'Most Logically Completes the Text'
description:
"Which choice most logically completes the text?" The right answer isn't the one that could be true. It's the one the passage guarantees. This lesson shows you how to find it.

You'll learn:
• What SAT inference questions are testing, and how to spot them
• A 3-step method: trace the logic, predict the ending, choose what the text guarantees
• How signal words (therefore, however, most likely) tell you what kind of ending you need
• The 4 traps: too strong, out of scope, reversed logic, and "true in real life"
• 6 practice questions from science, economics, art history, and archaeology

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Information and Ideas → Inferences).
